newsitem.title: USA: Therapeutic sees development funds used up.
newsitem.headline: Therapeutic sees development funds used up.

text.p: Therapeutic Discovery Corp said Tuesday it would exhaust its funds available for product development during the third quarter.
ALZA Corp's option to buy Therapeutic's Class A common stock will expire, if not exercised, within a specified period after Therapeutic exhausts its funds, the company said in a statement.
ALZA has an option to buy the outstanding Class A common stock at a price set according to a predetermined formula, it said.
Therapeutic's stock was up 1/4 at 11-3/4 on the Nasdaq in late morning trade.
The company has more than 7.0 million shares in circulation.
